## Core Practice Areas & Client Outcomes
1. Luxury Seller Representation ($1M–$10M+):
   - Comprehensive pricing strategy, property presentation, and targeted buyer-agent outreach.
   - Syndication across the 93,000-member MIAMI REALTORS® network, 260+ U.S. MLSs via RPR, and 200+ global consumer portals in 19 languages.
   - Contractual structuring of post-closing occupancy agreements (leasebacks up to 7+ months) enabling sellers to liquidate equity without displacement risk.
   - Tax window and transition coordination: Florida Save Our Homes assessment cap portability, FIRPTA compliance, and Section 121 exclusions in concert with client CPAs.
2. Miami Global Listing Desk (Bilateral Spain/LATAM Cross-Border Mandates):
   - Direct placement of prime European and Latin American properties (€1.5M+ in Madrid, Costa del Sol, and LATAM) on the Miami MLS as the licensed U.S. principal of record.
   - Direct exposure to 93,000 South Florida agents and international capital looking for European residential assets.
   - Cooperating local Spanish and LATAM agencies manage on-the-ground showings, local documentation, and regional negotiations.
3. Institutional Agent-to-Agent Referrals:
   - Written co-brokerage and fee protection agreements for domestic and international brokers referring high-net-worth clients to South Florida or Spain.
